## 10 · Consent granted
The entry point for a real user. Registers the anonymous subject on first use and writes one append-only ledger entry per scope.

**Refuses to resurrect an erased subject.** Expiry is set here, never by the client.

Workflow 01 reads what this writes, so without it no real assessment can start.

nodes.name: Decide subject state
nodes.notes: An erased subject is never silently re-enrolled.

nodes.name: Doc · consent entries
nodes.notes: One append-only row per scope, each with its own expiry.
